userStories.title: The feature record keeps the approval outcome, the CI detail and the story states
acceptanceCriteria: `askApproval` with an advisor whose decision is `{ id: "D-7", action: { type: "approve" }, rationale: "clean" }` returns `{ approved: true, rationale: "clean", decisionId: "D-7" }`.

`askApproval` with an advisor whose decision is `{ id: "D-1", action: { type: "hold", reason: "x" }, rationale: "risky" }` returns `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: risky", decisionId: "D-1" }`.

`askApproval` with an advisor that returns no decision and `fallbackReason` `"all models failed"` returns `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor unavailable: all models failed" }` with no `decisionId` key.
`askApproval` with an advisor whose `advise` throws `Error("boom")` returns an outcome with no `decisionId` key.
`ciReason("failed")` returns `"CI failed"`.
`ciReason("conflicting", "PR #9 has merge conflicts")` returns `"PR #9 has merge conflicts"`.
`ciReason("conflicting")` with no detail returns `"PR has merge conflicts with its base branch"`.
`ciReason` returns `undefined` for each of `"green"`, `"pending"` and `"skipped"`.
`readinessReasons` with the `READY` facts of `approval.test.ts` overridden by `ci` `"unavailable"` and `ciDetail` `"gh: 502"` returns exactly `["gh: 502"]`.

`publish`, wired with `wire({ outcome: "green", detail: "ok" }, { hold: { id: "D-1", rationale: "risky" } })` (every ready condition met), returns an outcome whose `approval` is `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: risky", decisionId: "D-1" }`.
`publish`, wired with `wire({ outcome: "failed", detail: "1 check failed" })`, returns an outcome with no `approval` key and never asks the advisor.
`publish`, wired with `wire({ outcome: "conflicting", detail: "PR #9 has merge conflicts" })`, returns an outcome whose `ciDetail` is `"PR #9 has merge conflicts"`.
`publish`, wired with `wire({ outcome: "green", detail: "3 checks passed" })`, returns an outcome with no `ciDetail` key.

`runFeatureMachine`, with a harness whose `published` script field holds an outcome with `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: r", decisionId: "D-1" }`, ends with a record whose `approval` equals that object.

`runFeatureMachine`, with a harness whose `published` script field holds an outcome with `ciDetail` `"PR #9 has merge conflicts"`, ends with a record whose `ciDetail` is `"PR #9 has merge conflicts"`.

`runFeatureMachine` with `facts.stories` `US-001` `complete` and `US-002` `complete-gate-open` with reason `red: lint` ends with a record whose `storyStates` is `[{ id: "US-001", state: "complete" }, { id: "US-002", state: "complete-gate-open", reason: "red: lint" }]`.
`runFeatureMachine` with no `published` script field (the default `PUBLISHED` outcome, which has no `approval`) ends with a record that has no `approval` key.

routing.reasoning: Multi-file but standard additive changes (types, return shape, extracted helper, record fields) with a small harness extension; no new abstractions beyond two interfaces.

modifiedFiles.reason: `askApproval` returns `ApprovalOutcome` with the decision id, and `ciReason` is extracted from `readinessReasons` with its output unchanged, as the Design states.
`PublishOutcome` gains `approval` and `ciDetail`, set where the advisor is asked and where the CI wait reported a detail-bearing state.
`publishStep` copies `approval` and `ciDetail` from the outcome and writes `storyStates` from `env.facts.stories`.
adds `ApprovalOutcome`, `StoryStateItem` and the three optional record fields.

the harness's `publish` step always returns the fixed `PUBLISHED` outcome. Add an optional `published?: PublishOutcome` script field that the `publish` step returns instead when set; every existing caller leaves it unset and keeps `PUBLISHED`.

"AC-21/22/23/24/25: conflict keeps draft" expects the `publish` result to equal exactly `{ outcome: "draft", ci: "conflicting", url, reasons: [...] }`; it now also carries `ciDetail: "PR has merge conflicts with main"`. `wire(ci)` gains an optional second argument `{ hold?: { id: string; rationale: string } }` that makes its advisor return a `hold` decision with that id and rationale instead of the approval; every existing call passes nothing. ACs 10-13 are added to this file.

ACs 1-9 are added here, and "asks finish-approval with an approve/hold menu and the evidence" expects exactly `{ approved: true, rationale: "clean" }` and "hold, no decision, or a throw" expects exactly `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: risky" }`. Both now also carry `decisionId`, the id of the decision `makeAdviceDecision` returned; the no-decision and throw cases still carry no `decisionId`.

"happy path: push, draft PR, CI pending, advisor approves -> promoted, ready" expects the outcome to equal exactly `{ outcome: "ready", ci: "pending", url, reasons: [] }`. It now also carries `approval: { approved: true, rationale, decisionId }` from the stub advisor's decision; the other fields are unchanged.

userStories.title: verdict.openItems lists advisor, story, CI and reason items
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Make `buildOpenItems` return the complete list of what keeps a feature from ready (advisor hold, flagged decisions, incomplete stories, blocking CI, unexplained reasons), and have the verdict and the draft PR body use it.

**Motivation** — `buildOpenItems` returns only `reviewOpen` findings, the branch review's cannot-verify items and red final gates; on run `auth-relogin-recovery` the only draft reason was the advisor's finish-approval hold and `verdict.openItems` held nothing explaining it, so a finishing tool had to rebuild the list by hand from four artifacts.

**Approach**
`OpenItem.kind` (`src/workflow/types.ts:96`): Baseline `"finding" | "ruling" | "cannot-verify" | "gate"`; Target adds `"advisor" | "story" | "ci" | "reason"`.

`buildOpenItems(rec: WorkflowFeatureRecord): OpenItem[]` (`src/workflow/open-items.ts:31`). Signature unchanged. `BLOCKING_KINDS` is unchanged (`finding`, `ruling`, `gate`), so `workflowPassed` keeps its meaning. It stays a short composition of per-kind helpers in `open-items.ts` (`advisorItems`, `storyItems`, `ciItem`, `reasonItems`, and `isExplained` for the rule below), each under the complexity limit of 20. It returns, in this order: the existing finding / ruling items, cannot-verify items and gate items, then:

| Kind | Source | `id` | `issue` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `advisor` | `rec.approval` with `approved: false` | `approval.decisionId`, else `_run:approval` | `approval.rationale` |
| `advisor` | each id in `rec.flaggedDecisions` not already an advisor item | the decision id | `advisor decision <id> needs a human: see nax advisor list` |
| `story` | each `rec.storyStates` entry whose `state` is not `complete` or `complete-with-rulings` | the story id | `<id> did not finish` for `not-run`; otherwise `<id> ended <state>`, followed by `: <reason>` when a reason is set |
| `ci` | `ciReason(rec.ci, rec.ciDetail)` is defined | `_run:ci` | that reason text |
| `reason` | each `rec.reasons` entry not explained (below) | `_run:reason<n>`, where `<n>` is the reason's 1-based position in `rec.reasons` (explained reasons keep their positions, so an id is stable when later reasons are appended) | the reason text |

A reason is **explained** when it equals a text nax produced for a fact that already has an item: a gate reason (`gates red: …`) while a gate item exists; the `ciReason` text while the `ci` item exists; `stories gate-open: <ids>` / `stories not run: <ids>` while a story item exists for every id it names; `approval.rationale` while the approval's advisor item exists; and `<n> ruling(s) flagged for a human` while `flaggedDecisions` yields at least `<n>` advisor items (counting the ids in `flaggedDecisions`, which span every run of the feature, and not the approval item). A flagged count with fewer such items (story flags and pre-flight holds are counted but are not always ledger decisions, and `flaggedDecisions` is absent when the ledger could not be read) is a `reason` item. `NOTHING_VERIFIED` has no gate item, so it is a `reason` item. `approval.ts` also exports `NOTHING_VERIFIED`, `gateReasons` and a `storyReasons(states)` helper producing the `stories gate-open: …` / `stories not run: …` texts, so `open-items.ts` matches the exact texts `readinessReasons` writes; `readinessReasons` uses `storyReasons`, so its output is unchanged.

Advisor items for `flaggedDecisions` appear in `result.json` only: `publishStep` collects those ids after `publish` returns, so the PR body, written inside `publish`, does not list them, and there the flagged count is a `reason` item. Its "Advisor decisions" section already names every decision.

`upsertFeatureRecord` (`src/workflow/result.ts:141`): builds the verdict from the record with `storyStates` taken from `result.stories` (`{ id, state: state ?? "not-run", reason? }`) when the record's `storyStates` is undefined; an empty array is kept as it is.

`PrParts` and `finishPr` (`finalize.ts:258`, `:264`): Baseline `PrParts { pr; body; draftUrl? }`; `finishPr(fc, parts, ci, reasons, approval: { approved; rationale } | null)`. Target: `PrParts` gains `record: WorkflowFeatureRecord` and `stories: readonly StorySummary[]` (set by `prMode` from `input`), and `finishPr`'s `approval` parameter is `ApprovalOutcome | null`. Since #2570, `prMode` holds the approval in a typed local, `let approval: { approved: boolean; rationale: string } | null`; it becomes `ApprovalOutcome | null`. The record's `reasons` is still empty at publish (`publishStep` is its only writer), so `finishPr` rebuilds the body's `openItems` from `buildOpenItems({ ...parts.record, approval, ci: ci.outcome, ciDetail, storyStates, reasons: finalReasons })`, where `ciDetail` is `ci.detail` only for `conflicting`, `no-checks` and `unavailable`, and `storyStates` comes from `parts.stories`. The draft's "Before marking ready" list then carries the advisor, story, CI and reason items the verdict does, under the same ids. Two exceptions: the flagged-decision items, and reasons `publish` appends after the body is written (`a human already marked the PR ready; nax left it as is`, `PR update failed: …`), which reach only the verdict. Those are always appended after `finalReasons`, so they never shift an earlier reason's position. `buildWorkflowPrBody`'s `openItemLine` renders any non-`gate` kind as `- [ ] **<id>** (<severity>, <kind>)` or `(<kind>)`; no rendering change is needed.

Test changes: `result.test.ts` 'upsertFeatureRecord writes a top-level verdict once the outcome is set' (record `reasons` `["r"]`) now expects `openItems: [{ id: "_run:reason1", kind: "reason", issue: "r" }]`; `workflowPassed`, `outcome` and `reasons` unchanged. ACs 20-23 use `wire()` with the `hold` option US-001 adds.

**Scope** — In: OpenItem.kind, buildOpenItems and helpers, upsertFeatureRecord storyStates fallback, PrParts/finishPr body rebuild, approval.ts exports (NOTHING_VERIFIED, gateReasons, storyReasons). Out: recording approval/ciDetail/storyStates on the record (US-001) and the CLI command (US-003). Feature-level: no new kind is blocking; flagged decisions are not listed in the PR body's "Before marking ready" list; minors are not open items.

**Interface**
```typescript
export type OpenItemKind = "finding" | "ruling" | "cannot-verify" | "gate" | "advisor" | "story" | "ci" | "reason";
export function buildOpenItems(rec: WorkflowFeatureRecord): OpenItem[];
// finalize.ts
interface PrParts { pr; body; draftUrl?; record: WorkflowFeatureRecord; stories: readonly StorySummary[] }
finishPr(fc, parts, ci, reasons, approval: ApprovalOutcome | null)
```
acceptanceCriteria: `buildOpenItems` on a record with `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: x", decisionId: "D-1" }` returns a list containing `{ id: "D-1", kind: "advisor", issue: "advisor held: x" }`.

`buildOpenItems` on a record with `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor unavailable: boom" }` and no `decisionId` returns a list containing `{ id: "_run:approval", kind: "advisor", issue: "advisor unavailable: boom" }`.
`buildOpenItems` on a record with `approval` `{ approved: true, rationale: "clean", decisionId: "D-7" }` returns no item with kind `advisor`.

`buildOpenItems` on a record with `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: x", decisionId: "D-1" }` and `flaggedDecisions` `["D-1", "D-3"]` returns exactly two `advisor` items, ids `D-1` then `D-3`, and the `D-3` item's `issue` starts with `advisor decision D-3 needs a human`.

`buildOpenItems` on a record with `storyStates` `US-001` `complete`, `US-002` `complete-with-rulings`, `US-003` `complete-gate-open` with reason `red: lint` and `US-004` `not-run` returns `story` items for exactly `US-003` and `US-004`, with issues `US-003 ended complete-gate-open: red: lint` and `US-004 did not finish`.
`buildOpenItems` on a record with `ci` `"failed"` returns a list containing `{ id: "_run:ci", kind: "ci", issue: "CI failed" }`.
`buildOpenItems` on a record with `ci` `"conflicting"` and `ciDetail` `"PR #9 has merge conflicts"` returns a `ci` item whose `issue` is `PR #9 has merge conflicts`.
`buildOpenItems` on records with `ci` `"green"`, `"pending"` and `"skipped"` returns no item with kind `ci` for any of them.

`buildOpenItems` on a record with `reasons` `["uncommitted changes after the branch fix", "branch review did not run"]` and no other facts returns `reason` items `_run:reason1` and `_run:reason2` carrying those two texts in that order.
`buildOpenItems` on a record with `finalGates` `{ ran: ["lint"], failing: ["lint"] }`, `reasons` `["gates red: lint"]` returns the `lint` gate item and no `reason` item.

`buildOpenItems` on a record with `ci` `"failed"`, a `storyStates` entry `US-003` in state `complete-gate-open`, `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: x", decisionId: "D-1" }` and `reasons` `["CI failed", "stories gate-open: US-003", "advisor held: x"]` returns no `reason` item.
`buildOpenItems` on a record with `reasons` `["2 ruling(s) flagged for a human"]` and `flaggedDecisions` `["D-3", "D-4"]` returns no `reason` item.
`buildOpenItems` on a record with `reasons` `["2 ruling(s) flagged for a human"]` and no `flaggedDecisions` returns one `reason` item `_run:reason1` carrying that text.

`buildOpenItems` on a record with `finalGates` `{ ran: ["lint"], failing: ["lint"] }` and `reasons` `["gates red: lint", "branch review did not run"]` returns one `reason` item, with id `_run:reason2`.

`buildOpenItems` on a record whose `finalGates` is `{ ran: [], failing: [] }` and whose `reasons` holds the nothing-verified text `readinessReasons` produces for it returns one `reason` item carrying that text.

`buildOpenItems` on a record with a `reviewOpen` finding, a cannot-verify item, a red gate, a held approval, a story state, a failed CI and an unexplained reason returns kinds in the order `finding`, `cannot-verify`, `gate`, `advisor`, `story`, `ci`, `reason`.
`buildVerdict` on a record with `passed` `true`, `outcome` `"draft"` and `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: x", decisionId: "D-1" }` returns `workflowPassed` `true`.

`upsertFeatureRecord` on a record with `outcome` `"draft"` and no `storyStates`, into a run directory whose `result.json` already holds a story record `US-002` with state `complete-gate-open`, writes a `verdict.openItems` containing a `story` item with id `US-002`.

`upsertFeatureRecord` on a record with `outcome` `"draft"` and `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: x", decisionId: "D-1" }` writes a `verdict.openItems` containing `{ id: "D-1", kind: "advisor", issue: "advisor held: x" }`.

`publish`, wired with `wire({ outcome: "green", detail: "ok" }, { hold: { id: "D-1", rationale: "risky" } })`, writes a final PR body whose "Before marking ready" section contains a line starting `- [ ] **D-1** (advisor) — advisor held:`.

`publish`, wired with `wire({ outcome: "failed", detail: "1 check failed" })`, writes a final PR body whose "Before marking ready" section contains a line starting `- [ ] **_run:ci** (ci) — CI failed`.

`publish`, wired with `wire({ outcome: "green", detail: "ok" })` and `input.stories` holding one summary `US-002` in state `complete-gate-open`, writes a final PR body whose "Before marking ready" section contains a line starting `- [ ] **US-002** (story)`.

`publish`, wired with `wire({ outcome: "green", detail: "ok" })` and `input.record.reviewRan` `false`, writes a final PR body whose "Before marking ready" section contains a line starting `- [ ] **_run:reason1** (reason) — branch review did not run`.

routing.reasoning: Four existing source files change with no new abstractions; the explained-reason rule is the only subtle part and is pinned by exact-text ACs that a single tdd-simple session can drive.

suggestedCriteria: `upsertFeatureRecord` on a record whose `storyStates` is an empty array writes a `verdict.openItems` with no `story` item even when `result.json` holds an unfinished story record.

modifiedFiles.reason: adds the advisor, story, CI and reason items and the explained-reason rule.
`upsertFeatureRecord` passes `storyStates` from `result.stories` to `buildVerdict` when the record has none.
`PrParts` gains `record` and `stories`, `finishPr` takes `ApprovalOutcome | null` and rebuilds the body's `openItems` with the approval, CI, story and reason facts, as the Design states.
also exports `NOTHING_VERIFIED`, `gateReasons` and `storyReasons`; `readinessReasons` uses `storyReasons`, so its output is unchanged.
ACs 20-23 are added here, using `wire()` with the `hold` option US-001 adds.

ACs 18-19 are added here, and "upsertFeatureRecord writes a top-level verdict once the outcome is set" expects `openItems: []` for a record whose `reasons` is `["r"]`. `r` is now an unexplained reason, so the expected `openItems` is `[{ id: "_run:reason1", kind: "reason", issue: "r" }]`; `workflowPassed`, `outcome` and `reasons` are unchanged.

userStories.title: nax workflow status
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add the read-only command `nax workflow status -f <feature> [--json]` that prints the verdict for the feature's newest workflow run.

**Motivation** — A finishing tool (the nax-finish skill today) rebuilds the open-items list by hand from `result.json`, `branch-rereview.json`, the ledger and the advisor ledger, parsing shapes that failed in practice; one command should print the list instead.

**Approach**
`nax workflow status -f <feature> [--json] [-d <dir>]`, registered by `registerWorkflowCommand(program, deps?)` in `src/cli/workflow.ts` with `_workflowCliDeps = { log, logErr, exit }` (writing through `console.log` / `console.error` inside the deps, as `_advisorCliDeps` does), exported from `src/cli/index.ts` and called from `bin/nax.ts` beside `registerAdvisorCommand`. Mirror the command-group pattern of `src/cli/advisor.ts` (injectable `log` / `logErr` / `exit`, `guarded` action). Read-only: it reads `.nax/features/<feature>/workflow/*/result.json` and writes nothing.

It validates the feature name with `validateFeatureName` (`src/utils/feature-name.ts`, throws a `NaxError`, e.g. `Feature name must be a single path segment: ../x`) before building any path, takes the newest run directory from `runDirsNewestFirst(workflowFeatureDir(dir, feature))`, and reads its `result.json` via `readResult`. It builds `openItems` with `buildOpenItems` from `featureWorkflow`, with `storyStates` filled from `result.stories` when the record has none (the same rule as `upsertFeatureRecord`: `{ id, state: state ?? "not-run", reason? }`), so a `result.json` written by an older nax reports the same items a fresh run would, and a run that never reached publish still reports its items. `workflowPassed` comes from `buildVerdict` and is omitted when the record has no `outcome`. `runId` is the run directory's name. `validateDirectory(dirPath, baseDir?)` (`src/config/path-security.ts`) is available for the `-d` option.

`--json` prints one object on stdout:
```json
{
  "feature": "auth-relogin-recovery",
  "runId": "336c1511-13b3-42b4-9924-7b8015d4c4f9",
  "runDir": ".nax/features/auth-relogin-recovery/workflow/336c1511-13b3-42b4-9924-7b8015d4c4f9",
  "step": "done",
  "outcome": "draft",
  "ci": "green",
  "url": "https://github.com/nathapp-io/nax/pull/2566",
  "workflowPassed": true,
  "reasons": ["advisor held: …"],
  "openItems": [{ "id": "D-1", "kind": "advisor", "issue": "advisor held: …" }]
}
```
`runDir` is relative to the project directory. `outcome`, `ci`, `url` and `workflowPassed` are omitted when the record has none (a run that never reached publish).

Without `--json` it prints `<feature>: <outcome> <url>` on the first line (`<outcome>` is `not published` when absent), then one line per open item, `- [<kind>] <id> — <issue>`, and `No open items.` when the list is empty.

Exit codes: `0` when the outcome is `ready` and `openItems` is empty; `2` otherwise, including a record with no `outcome` (something needs a human); `1` on an error: an invalid feature name, no `.nax/` directory, no workflow run with a readable `result.json`, or a `result.json` with no `featureWorkflow`. On an error, `--json` prints `{"error":"<message>"}` on stdout and plain mode prints the message on stderr.

Failure handling:
| Situation | Behaviour |
|:--|:--|
| `validateFeatureName` rejects the feature name | exit 1 with its message, no file read |
| No run directory holds a `result.json` | exit 1 with `no workflow result for feature <feature>` |
| The newest `result.json` has no `featureWorkflow` | exit 1 with `workflow for <feature> has not started its feature steps (run <runId>)` |
| The newest `result.json` is unreadable or not JSON | `readResult` returns null for it; the command moves to the next-newest run directory |

Verification note: the `bin/nax.ts` registration line (`registerWorkflowCommand(program)` after `registerAdvisorCommand`) is checked by `bun run typecheck` and `bun run build`; no unit test spawns the `nax` binary (forbidden by the test rules), so a missing registration is a known gap that review of the `bin/nax.ts` diff covers. CLI tests mirror `test/unit/cli/advisor-list-label.test.ts`.

**Scope** — In: `src/cli/workflow.ts`, barrel exports (`registerWorkflowCommand`, `_workflowCliDeps`, `WorkflowCliDeps`, `workflowStatusCommand`), `bin/nax.ts` registration. Out: any change to buildOpenItems/record shape (US-001/US-002). Feature-level: no forge reads (CI state is the one recorded at publish), no `nax gates run` / `workflow record` / `workflow promote`, no full advisor decision objects in the output, and the command writes nothing.

**Interface**
```typescript
export interface WorkflowCliDeps { log: (msg: string) => void; logErr: (msg: string) => void; exit: (code: number) => void }
export const _workflowCliDeps: WorkflowCliDeps;
export function registerWorkflowCommand(program: Command, deps?: WorkflowCliDeps): Command; // group named "workflow", subcommand "status"
export function workflowStatusCommand(...): Promise<void>;
```
acceptanceCriteria: `workflow status -f auth --json -d <dir>`, where `<dir>/.nax/features/auth/workflow/r1/result.json` holds a `featureWorkflow` with `outcome` `"draft"`, `url` `"https://gh/pr/7"`, `ci` `"green"` and `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: x", decisionId: "D-1" }`, prints one JSON object whose `feature` is `auth`, `runId` is `r1`, `outcome` is `draft`, `url` is `https://gh/pr/7` and `openItems` contains the `D-1` advisor item.

`workflow status -f auth --json` on a `result.json` whose `featureWorkflow` has `outcome` `"draft"` and `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: x", decisionId: "D-1" }` exits with code 2.
`workflow status -f auth --json` on a `result.json` whose `featureWorkflow` has `outcome` `"ready"`, `passed` `true` and nothing open prints `openItems` `[]` and exits with code 0.
`workflow status -f auth --json` on a `result.json` whose `featureWorkflow` has `outcome` `"ready"` and one `cannotVerify` entry exits with code 2.

`workflow status -f auth --json` on a `result.json` with no `verdict` key, whose `featureWorkflow` has `outcome` `"draft"` and no `storyStates`, and whose `stories` holds `US-002` with state `complete-gate-open`, prints `openItems` containing a `story` item with id `US-002`.
With two run directories `r-old` and `r-new` under `.nax/features/auth/workflow/`, where `r-new/result.json` has the later modification time, `workflow status -f auth --json` prints `runId` `r-new`.
When the newer run directory's `result.json` is not valid JSON, `workflow status -f auth --json` prints the older run directory's `runId`.
`workflow status -f auth --json` with no `.nax/features/auth/workflow/` directory prints `{"error":"no workflow result for feature auth"}` and exits with code 1.
`workflow status -f ../x --json` prints an object whose `error` is `Feature name must be a single path segment: ../x`, exits with code 1, and reads no file.
`workflow status -f auth --json` on a `result.json` with no `featureWorkflow` prints an object whose `error` starts with `workflow for auth has not started its feature steps` and exits with code 1.

`workflow status -f auth` without `--json`, on a `result.json` whose `featureWorkflow` has `outcome` `"draft"`, `url` `"https://gh/pr/7"` and `approval` `{ approved: false, rationale: "advisor held: x", decisionId: "D-1" }`, prints `auth: draft https://gh/pr/7` as its first line and a line `- [advisor] D-1 — advisor held: x`.
`workflow status -f auth` without `--json`, on a `result.json` whose `featureWorkflow` has `outcome` `"ready"`, `passed` `true` and nothing open, prints a line `No open items.`.

`workflow status -f auth --json` on a `result.json` whose `featureWorkflow` has no `outcome` and whose `stories` holds `US-002` with state `complete-gate-open` prints `openItems` containing a `story` item with id `US-002`, prints an object with no `outcome` and no `workflowPassed` key, and exits with code 2.
After `workflow status -f auth --json` runs, the bytes of every `result.json` under `.nax/features/auth/workflow/` and the list of entries in that directory are unchanged.

Importing `registerWorkflowCommand` and `workflowStatusCommand` from the nax `cli` barrel succeeds, and `registerWorkflowCommand(new Command())` returns a command group named `workflow` with a subcommand `status`.

routing.reasoning: New CLI command following an existing in-repo pattern (advisor.ts) that composes already-built helpers; 2-5 files, no new abstractions.

analysis:
Phase 1 of #2569. verdict.openItems in a workflow result.json must become the complete list of what keeps a feature from ready, and a new read-only command `nax workflow status -f <feature> [--json]` prints it for the newest run.

Key files (all under packages/nax, verified by the spec on main 1421eacde):
- src/workflow/approval.ts: readinessReasons (:62) builds the reason texts in order (gates red / NOTHING_VERIFIED, CI failed, conflicting/no-checks/unavailable via f.ciDetail ?? default, stories gate-open, stories not run, N ruling(s) flagged for a human, branch review did not run, describeUnread, RE_REVIEW_SKIPPED, COST_LIMITED). askApproval (:98) returns { approved, rationale } with no decision id. US-001 changes it to ApprovalOutcome and extracts ciReason; US-002 exports NOTHING_VERIFIED, gateReasons and storyReasons. readinessReasons output must stay unchanged in both.
- src/workflow/finalize.ts: PublishOutcome (:37), PrParts (:194), finishPr (:200), publish. US-001 adds approval/ciDetail to PublishOutcome; US-002 adds record/stories to PrParts and rebuilds the PR body openItems in finishPr.
- src/workflow/feature-machine.ts: publishStep (:453) copies approval/ciDetail from the outcome and builds storyStates from env.facts.stories ({id,state,reason?} in that key order, reason omitted when absent).
- src/workflow/types.ts: WorkflowFeatureRecord (:172), OpenItem.kind (:96), StorySummary (:159), WorkflowStoryRecord (:54). Add ApprovalOutcome, StoryStateItem, three optional record fields, and the new OpenItem kinds.
- src/workflow/open-items.ts: buildOpenItems (:31) composes per-kind helpers (advisorItems, storyItems, ciItem, reasonItems, isExplained), each under complexity 20. BLOCKING_KINDS stays finding/ruling/gate so workflowPassed is unchanged.
- src/workflow/result.ts: upsertFeatureRecord (:141), readResult (:33), runDirsNewestFirst (:121). upsertFeatureRecord fills storyStates from result.stories when the record has none (empty array is kept).
- src/workflow/paths.ts workflowFeatureDir; src/workflow/ci-wait.ts CiWaitResult; src/workflow/pr-body.ts openItemLine renders non-gate kinds generically so no rendering change.
- src/cli/advisor.ts (registerAdvisorCommand, _advisorCliDeps, guarded) is the pattern for src/cli/workflow.ts; src/cli/index.ts barrel; bin/nax.ts registers commands; src/utils/feature-name.ts validateFeatureName; src/config/path-security.ts validateDirectory.

Tests to touch: test/unit/workflow/approval.test.ts, finalize.test.ts, finalize-ci-gate.test.ts (wire() gains optional second arg { hold }), result.test.ts, open-items.test.ts, test/helpers/workflow-feature-machine.ts (add optional `published?: PublishOutcome` script field; default stays PUBLISHED), test/unit/cli/advisor-list-label.test.ts (CLI harness to mirror). Existing tests whose exact-equality expectations change: finalize-ci-gate 'conflict keeps draft' (adds ciDetail), approval.test askApproval cases (add decisionId on decision paths only), finalize.test 'happy path' (adds approval), result.test 'writes a top-level verdict' (openItems becomes [{id:'_run:reason1',kind:'reason',issue:'r'}]).

Risks: (1) readinessReasons output must not change when ciReason/storyReasons are extracted. (2) The explained-reason rule must match exact texts nax produces; reason ids are 1-based positions in rec.reasons and explained reasons keep their positions. (3) Flagged-decision advisor items appear only in result.json, never in the PR body (publishStep collects ids after publish returns); there the flagged count is a reason item. Reasons appended after the body is written reach only the verdict. (4) Old result.json records lack approval/ciDetail/storyStates; CLI and upsertFeatureRecord fall back to result.stories. (5) nax exits 0 on failure elsewhere, but this command has its own exit codes: 0 ready+no items, 2 otherwise, 1 on error. (6) Optional keys must be absent (not undefined) where ACs say 'no key'. (7) Follow repo rules: immutable updates, files under 800 lines, no console.log outside the injectable deps, never run bare `bun test` or `bun run nax`; package commands run from packages/nax. No test spawns the nax binary.

Migration: all new record fields are optional; no data migration needed.
outOfScope: `nax gates run`, `nax workflow record` and `nax workflow promote` (phases 2 and 3 of #2569).
Reading live PR checks or mergeability from the forge: `nax workflow status` reports the CI state recorded at publish time.
Making any of the new kinds blocking for `workflowPassed`: `BLOCKING_KINDS` stays `finding`, `ruling`, `gate`.
Listing `leave` minors, `newMinors` or fix-now minors as open items.
Listing flagged advisor decisions in the PR body's "Before marking ready" list.
Including the full advisor decision objects in the `nax workflow status` output; `nax advisor list -f <feature> --json` stays the source for them.
Pipeline execution mode, which is frozen.

A test that the built `nax` binary registers the `workflow` group: no test spawns the binary (the test rules forbid it). The `bin/nax.ts` diff review and a `bun run dev workflow status --help` check after merge cover it.
Updating the nax-finish skill to call `nax workflow status`; that change lands in nathapp-io/nax-toolkit-skills.
